label: trustmark
comment: The trust mark image awarded by the AB to the CAB to indicate accreditation.
The trust mark or seal used by this conformity scheme.

rangeIncludes.comment: A binary file reference including name and file type.

domainIncludes.comment: The authority under which a conformity claim is issued.  For example a national accreditation authority may authorise a test lab to issue test certificates about a product against a standard.
A formal governance scheme under which this attestation is issued (eg ACRS structural steel certification)
